items.source: Returns the MethodInterceptor to be used for the given source object and target type.
items.translation: 返回用于给定源对象和目标类型的 MethodInterceptor。

items.source: Returns whether the current factory is supposed to be used to create a MethodInterceptor for proxy of the given target type.
items.translation: 返回当前工厂是否应该用于为给定目标类型创建代理的 MethodInterceptor。

items.source: SPI to create MethodInterceptor instances based on the given source object and the target type to produce. To be registered with a ProxyProjectionFactory to customize the way method executions on projection proxies are handled.
items.translation: SPI 用于根据给定的源对象和目标类型创建 MethodInterceptor 实例，以便注册到 ProxyProjectionFactory 中，从而自定义投影代理上方法执行的处理方式。
source 永远不会为 null。
targetType - 永远不会为 null。
